fields.title: Update on changes to patents services

main_text:
Update on changes to patents services
Patents service update: November 2026
On 27 October 2026 we announced that we expect to retire the legacy Web Filing service in early December. We are now targeting early January 2027 to ensure a smooth transition away from the legacy services.
The vast majority of customers have now moved over to the new patents service. Only about 5% of requests are now coming through the legacy Web Filing service. We have also been working closely with the customers that are still using it to understand their needs. We are confident we can retire Web Filing with minimal impact on our customers.
However, we understand the importance of having a back-up option that you can have confidence in. We’ve been working on a contingency filing service to address this.
The approach
To ensure that you have confidence in the contingency filing service, we will be working with CIPA, IP Federation and other customers to conduct live testing over the next couple of weeks. If the outcome of this testing is satisfactory, we will roll out the contingency filing service for everyone and confirm a final retirement date for the Web Filing service.
This means that the steps for launching the contingency filing service and retiring Web Filing will be:
The contingency filing service will be made available to a limited group of customers this week.
Approximately two weeks later we will confirm the outcome of the testing. If all parties are satisfied, the contingency service will be made available to everyone and a final date for retiring Web Filing will be confirmed
The Web Filing service will be retired on the confirmed date. Our target is to retire Web Filing in early January 2027.
Why we’re retiring Web Filing
There are three reasons that we want to retire the Web Filing service as soon as possible:
Requests submitted via the Web Filing service have to be manually keyed into our new system, resulting in a slow and poor customer experience.
Retiring the Web Filing service is a necessary step for us to turn on long-awaited features in our new patents service. For example, requesting a change of name and change of address for your patent, which are coming in early 2027.
Running two systems at once has caused confusion and complications for customers, especially regarding email correspondence.
Services that will be unchanged
There will be no changes to the following patent services at this time:
you can send any patent and SPC request via forms@ipo.gov.uk
you can send patent withdrawal requests via withdraw@ipo.gov.uk
you can request extensions to patent deadlines via pateot@ipo.gov.uk
We intend to retire forms@ipo.gov.uk for patent requests at some point in 2027, but no specific timeline has yet been decided. It will remain in place for requests related to trade marks and registered designs for the foreseeable future.
The withdraw@ipo.gov.uk and pateot@ipo.gov.uk email addresses will remain in place for the foreseeable future.
Contingency filing service
The contingency filing service will be accessible at any time but is intended only for when you can’t use the new service. This could either be because there’s a problem with the service, or you are having a problem using the service.
Situations where using the contingency service is appropriate include:
the patents service is unavailable
you can’t do something you need to, because a feature isn’t working or isn’t available
there’s something else preventing you from submitting a request that you can’t overcome
The contingency filing service can be used to submit any patent request, not only new patent applications. It also uses a complete separate platform and technology from our other services to add extra resilience to our services.
You can find out more about the Contingency file upload service on our guidance page. You can also find out what it looks like and how we’ve developed the services alongside customers in our LinkedIn article on the contingency service.
Improvements to the new patents service
On 29 October we rolled out a new ‘submission receipt’ feature which gives you an immediate receipt of your application details.
We will be introducing a further improvement to this by the end of 2026, that allows you to access your submission receipt at any time from the ‘pending applications’ page in your account.
You can find out more about the improvements we’ve already made and what we have planned from:
our Patents service updates and improvements page where we publish details of the latest updates we’ve made to the service
our roadmap of planned improvements which shows the improvements we’ll be making in the future
our LinkedIn article on how the upcoming submission receipts feature will work
Get in touch
If you have any questions about either decommissioning of our legacy services or the new service, contact information@ipo.gov.uk.
Archive
When this page is updated old content will be removed so it remains current. You can find previous updates by viewing the archive timeline of this page, which can be searched by calendar date.
